Vigenère Cipher Tool

Encode and decode messages with the Vigenère polyalphabetic cipher using your own keyword.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your message and a keyword (letters only).
  2. Choose Encode or Decode.
  3. Press Run.
  4. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does Vigenère work?

Each letter is shifted by the corresponding keyword letter (A=0 … Z=25), repeating the keyword across the message.

What makes a good keyword?

Use letters only — digits and spaces are ignored. A longer, less predictable keyword is stronger.

Does it keep capitalization?

Letter case and punctuation are preserved; only A–Z letters are transformed.
